reuse.why: Every month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending, goes through the existing shouldBudgetCategory and averageToBudgetAmount helpers, but the category query is not shared.

duplication.why: The category query with the new has_template/group_fixed columns (notes join, goal_def IS NOT NULL, LIKE '%#fixed%') is written out in setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg and again in getBudgetData.

placement.why: The hidden/fixed/template decision belongs in month-budget-categories.ts and does go there, but what counts as 'has a template' and 'fixed group' is defined in SQL at six query sites, so part of the rule sits in the data layer of each action.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps (exclusions, new action, fixed groups, includeHiddenCategories), plus tests.

maintainability.why: The helper is the single gate, but changing the template or #fixed definition means editing six SQL strings, and the now-unused `action` parameter of shouldBudgetCategory is left in place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions call shouldBudgetCategory; none skip it.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated category queries in actions.ts are visible near-verbatim copies (only whitespace differs), not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldBudgetCategory (month-budget-categories.ts) gains includeHiddenCategories and two input fields, and its `action` parameter is now unused; the has_template and group_fixed flags it decides on are computed separately in six SQL queries in actions.ts (getBudgetData, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg) rather than by the shared definition.
